question: Baishagu is celebrated in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Baishagu is a prominent festival celebrated by the Bodo tribe in Assam.
 
• This festival marks the beginning of the Assamese New Year and is celebrated during the mid-April.
 
• Baishagu involves traditional dance forms such as the Bwisagu dance, performed to the tunes of traditional musical instruments.
 
• The festival is characterized by rituals that honor the local deities and ancestors, as well as community feasting and merrymaking.
 
• It is one of the most vibrant and significant cultural festivals in Assam, reflecting the rich heritage of the Bodo community.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bodo Tribe:**

 
 
• The Bodos are one of the largest ethnic and linguistic groups in Assam, belonging to the Bodo-Kachari community.
 
• They speak the Bodo language, which is recognized as one of the 22 scheduled languages of India.
 
• The Bodo people primarily inhabit the Bodoland Territorial Region in Assam.
 
 
 
• **Assamese New Year:**
 
 
• The Assamese New Year, also known as Rongali Bihu, is celebrated in mid-April.
 
• It marks the beginning of the agricultural cycle, especially the onset of the sowing season.
 
• Rongali Bihu is a time of joy and festivities, involving traditional music, dance, and feasts.
 
 
 
• **Traditional Music and Dance:**
 
 
• The Bwisagu dance is performed during Baishagu with traditional Bodo musical instruments like kham (drum) and sifung (flute).
 
• Dance and music are integral parts of the festival, showcasing the cultural richness of the Bodo community.
 
 
 
• **Cultural Significance:**
 
 
• Festivals like Baishagu play a crucial role in preserving and promoting the cultural heritage of indigenous communities.
 
• They foster community bonding and provide an opportunity to pass traditions and customs to younger generations.
